fact: KNBS and the National Treasury published the 38-page Statistics Bill, 2026, which would establish the Kenya Statistics Authority in place of KNBS and repeal the Statistics Act (Cap. 112); the document is a bill, undated for signature, not an enacted law.

The document is the text of Kenya's Statistics Act (Cap. 112), assented to on 23 August 2006 and commenced on 1 February 2007, establishing the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics; this version is the consolidated revision to 31 December 2022.
